references.text: The wave offering (תְּנוּפָה) is mentioned here as part of the consecration ceremony, the same ritual action as with the sheaf in Leviticus 23:11
The counting of seven weeks begins from the day after the Sabbath when the sheaf was waved, linking the firstfruits offering to Pentecost
The firstfruits offering of grain is mentioned here as part of the grain offering laws, related to the omer offering
The counting of seven weeks from the sickle placed in the grain parallels the counting from the omer waving
The people of Israel ate from the land's produce the day after Passover, after the firstfruits had been offered
The firstfruits of the grain were to be brought to the Lord's house, following the same principle as the omer offering
Paul describes Christ as the firstfruits (ἀπαρχή) of those who have died, fulfilled at his resurrection on the day after the Sabbath
Believers are described as a firstfruit (ἀπαρχήν) of God's creation, linking to the omer offering as firstfruits
